notes.title: Update v30550 released!
notes.notes:
A new version of Gold Crusader is now live!

[code]
- updated to Unreal Engine 4.14
- updated Steamworks integration
- activated Steam Cloud
- minor fixes in the dungeon creator
[/code]

 Steam Achievments 
Due to some problems with some of the Achivements I was forced to remove some Achivements. I wasn't able to get those working for unknown reason. (In debugg mode I can see the progress of writing the achievment is successful but for some unknown reason it's not unlocked in Steam)

I removed those "broken" achievemntes for now that 100% is possible to archive.

 Trading Cards
I have reconfigured the entire Trading Card setup and it's now awaiting aproval from Valve. After aproval Tradingcards should work as expected.

Like West Forest Games on Facebook.
